notes.content: [p]🎮 [b]Xbox Controller Support:[/b] Playing PathUp! is now even easier for all Xbox controller users.[/p][p]🌐 [b]Language Selection:[/b] The language selection option has been moved from the main menu to [b]Settings[/b] for easier and more logical access.[/p][p]⚡ [b]Improved Gameplay:[/b] We’ve optimized game mechanics to make levels smoother and gameplay more enjoyable.[/p][p]🔧 [b]Minor Improvements & Fixes:[/b] Fixed minor bugs, improved stability, and enhanced control comfort.[/p]

notes.title: 🔥 PathUp! Update — New Modes for Every Climber!
notes.content:
PathUp! just leveled up — and so can you. With the latest update, the game now offers three distinct difficulty modes tailored for every type of player:

✦ Easy Mode – a smooth journey with 13 checkpoints

✦ Medium Mode – a real challenge with just 5 checkpoints

✦ Hard Mode – for true masters: only 1 checkpoint

Every climb is a test. Every mistake matters. Whether you want a relaxing experience or a nerve-wracking thrill, PathUp! now adapts to your playstyle.

🚀 The update is live! Download now and see how far you can go.

notes.title: Small but Meaningful Update
notes.content: We’ve fixed several areas that previously caused gameplay issues. While this is not a major update, it noticeably improves the overall gameplay experience, making things smoother and more enjoyable. Thanks for playing and for your continued support!

notes.title: ✨ PathUp! Update is Live! ✨
notes.content:
Dear players,
We’re excited to announce the release of a new update for PathUp, bringing several fantastic improvements!

🌄 The world has been slightly beautified to enhance the atmosphere and make your journey even more enjoyable.
⚙️ Optimization has been performed, leading to noticeable performance improvements.
📝 Translation errors across different languages have been fixed for a better experience.
🐞 Minor bugs have been resolved for smoother gameplay.

Thank you for your continued support! Your feedback keeps us pushing forward.

Climb to the top now—smoother and more beautiful than ever! 🚗⛰️

notes.title: PathUp! Update 1․404
notes.content:
✨ PathUp! Update is here! ✨

Dear players,

We’ve just released a small but meaningful update for PathUp!

🛠️ Fixed several bugs to improve the gameplay experience.
🎮 Added new collisions to make the game more dynamic.
✅ Introduced an additional checkpoint for better balance.
🌄 Slightly improved visuals to enhance the game’s look and feel.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback! We’ll keep working to make PathUp! even better.

Good luck reaching the top! 🚗⛰️

notes.title: PathUp — New Update: Higher, Better!
notes.content:
Thank you to all the players who have shared their feedback. In this update, I’ve focused on fixing some of the most critical issues, such as unclear collisions and invisible surfaces. Now, certain areas will have more precise hitboxes, preventing unexpected vehicle stalls or falls.

Additionally, new checkpoints have been added, allowing players to rejoin the game with minimal loss.

The most notable change is that the game’s end point has been moved from 2300 meters to 2550 meters. So, your journey is now a bit longer, a bit more challenging, but definitely more exciting.

The game continues to evolve, and I’ll keep listening to everyone’s voice.
